# About this directory

Everything here was generated by `spu agent`. The record of what was generated, from
which version, and with which answers is in `spu.json` beside this file.

## Do not edit the generated files

A change to one of them is not lost the first time, but it is a change spu has to treat
as somebody else's work: it stops and asks before replacing a file that no longer matches
what it wrote.

If you want to add to a document, write your own beside it and say so in your project's
`AGENTS.md` or `CLAUDE.md`. A document you own is never touched.

If you want to change what a document says, change the answer it was generated from:

```sh
spu agent edit      # answer one item's questions again
spu agent           # choose again what to generate
```

If you want a document to stop being generated, clear it in the picker. The file stays
where it is; spu simply stops claiming it, and from then on it is yours.

## What is where

- `spu.json` — the ledger. Which items were generated, with which answers, and the hash
  of each file as it was written.
- `prompts/` — the conventions documents.
- `skills/` — skills, each a directory with a `SKILL.md`.
- `README.spu.md` — this file.

## Where the harnesses read from

This directory is the canonical copy. Two of the three harnesses read it directly:

| Harness | Skills | Instructions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Claude Code | `.claude/skills` (a link to `../.agents/skills`) | `CLAUDE.md` |
| Codex | `.agents/skills`, read natively | `AGENTS.md` |
| Pi | `.agents/skills`, read natively | `AGENTS.md` |

The single link exists because Claude Code is the only one of the three that does not
read `.agents/skills`; it offers to import from it, which copies rather than tracks.

## Checking

```sh
spu agent status
```

reports what is missing and what has changed since it was generated. It writes nothing.
